methodologyNotes: Published self-serve pricing for note-taking and knowledge apps was collected directly from each provider's public pricing page on the accessedAt date and recorded in USD. Each plan was independently re-verified on 2026-06-13 by fetching the provider's live pricing page; only providers whose prices/discounts/limits could be confirmed on a real provider-controlled page are retained. Where a provider prices per seat/user/editor, monthlyUsd records that per-unit list price with billingModel per_seat and the annual-vs-monthly rates noted in the plan notes; flat-priced or per-account/per-site tiers record the flat monthly fee with billingModel flat. Quote-only / contact-sales / Enterprise tiers carry a null price rather than an estimate. These are not telephony products, so minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin and overagePerCall are null on every plan, and HIPAA/BAA/bilingual are null unless a provider states otherwise. Providers whose pricing pages render figures only client-side (no price visible in the served page) and could not be corroborated on a real provider page were dropped rather than retained on an unverifiable guess: Evernote, Coda, Capacities and Roam Research were dropped on this pass for that reason (Roam additionally showed conflicting third-party annual rates).

End-to-end encryption, unlimited device sync on web, desktop and mobile, plain-text notes, offline access, tags, per-note password protection, full encrypted or plaintext export, two-factor authentication, daily encrypted email backups, community support. The catch: plain text only (no Super notes, markdown editor or spreadsheets) and note revision history covers the current session only.

plans.name: Productivity
plans.notes: Per account, sold on two terms only: $90 / year, or a five-year prepay of $299 / 5 years (the 5-year option was missing from an earlier version of this record and was added on this read). No month-to-month price is offered anywhere on the page, so no monthly price is recorded; the $299 is a multi-year prepay and likewise never a monthly figure. Adds the Super note type (markdown, rich text, checklists, code), spreadsheets with formulas, Daily Notebooks journaling, a built-in 2FA authenticator, folders, the Web Clipper, 1-year note revision history, sign-in email notifications and dedicated support. There is no free trial — the page states 'We don't have a trial system at present' and substitutes a 14-day 100% refund period. Students get 30% off.

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: Per account, sold as $120 / year or a five-year prepay of $349 / 5 years (the 5-year option was missing from an earlier version of this record and was added on this read). No monthly rate exists, so no monthly price is recorded. Everything in Productivity plus 100 GB encrypted cloud storage, subscription sharing with up to 5 accounts, no file-size limit (the page says tested up to 2 GB), offline file access, local file backups, Moments daily self-photos, maximum note revision history and hardware security key support. The refund window extends to 90 days on this tier. Shared across 5 accounts it is the cheapest family option here, but it is still annual-or-longer only.

vendors.name: Joplin
vendors.provenance: VERIFIED, no changes. https://joplinapp.org/plans/ was re-fetched and every figure matches an earlier version of this record exactly, all printed in EUR with no USD list price and no currency switcher: Basic 2.99€/month or 2.40€/month yearly (28.69€/year); Pro 5.99€ or 4.79€ yearly (57.48€/year); Pro 100 GB 9.99€ or 7.99€ yearly (95.88€/year); Teams 7.99€ or 6.69€ yearly per user (80.28€/user/year); Server Business 3.33€ / 2.92€ / 2.50€ per user per month by seat band. No monthly price is therefore recorded on any paid row, and the EUR figures live in the notes, unconverted. The 14-day trial and the GDPR sentence were confirmed verbatim.

plans.name: Joplin app (self-managed sync)
plans.notes: The app itself is free and open source on Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS and terminal, funded by Joplin Cloud subscriptions and donations. Notes are stored in an open format with optional end-to-end encryption, and sync can run through third-party services — the homepage names Dropbox and OneDrive alongside Joplin Cloud — so you can use Joplin indefinitely at $0 and bring your own storage. Publishing notes to the web and notebook sharing are Joplin Cloud features, not app features.

plans.name: Joplin Cloud Basic
plans.notes: Priced in EUR only: 2.99€/month month-to-month, or 2.40€/month billed yearly (28.69€/year). No USD price is published anywhere on the page, so no monthly price is recorded, and no FX conversion was applied. Includes 2 GB storage, a 10 MB cap per note or attachment, publishing notes to the internet, unlimited device sync, the Joplin Web App, collaborating on a notebook someone shares with you, and Joplin Cloud AI (beta). Note the asymmetry a buyer gets caught by: Basic can collaborate on a notebook but cannot share one out — that needs Pro. 14-day free trial. No annual saving percentage is printed.

plans.name: Joplin Cloud Pro
plans.notes: EUR only: 5.99€/month, or 4.79€/month billed yearly (57.48€/year); no monthly price is recorded because no USD price exists. 30 GB storage (upgradeable to 100 GB), 200 MB per note or attachment, plus Email to Note, a customisable publishing banner, sharing notebooks with others, share permissions and priority support. 14-day free trial.

plans.name: Joplin Cloud Pro 100 GB
plans.notes: EUR only: 9.99€/month, or 7.99€/month billed yearly (95.88€/year); no monthly price is recorded. Identical to Pro except storage rises to 100 GB (the page presents it as a storage upgrade of Pro, toggled with 'Upgrade to 100 GB' / 'Back to 30 GB'). 200 MB per note or attachment. 14-day free trial.

plans.name: Joplin Cloud Teams
plans.notes: EUR only and charged per user: 7.99€/user/month, or 6.69€/user/month billed yearly (80.28€/user/year); no monthly price is recorded. Minimum of 2 users, so the real floor is about 15.98€/month. 50 GB storage per user, 200 MB per note or attachment, all Pro features plus managing multiple users, consolidated billing and share permissions. 14-day free trial.

plans.name: Joplin Server Business (self-hosted)
plans.notes: Self-hosted licence, EUR only, billed annually with no monthly option: 3.33€/user/month for 2-10 users, 2.92€/user/month for 11-50, 2.50€/user/month for 51+ — stated on the page as 40.00 / 35.00 / 30.00 EUR per user per year respectively. Unlimited storage and unlimited attachment size, source code available, all enterprise features; the Joplin Web App is the one feature marked unavailable on this tier. 14-day free trial. Bulk discounts for companies, associations and nonprofits are offered on request.

keyIntegrations: Web Clipper for Chrome and Firefox

vendors.name: Amplenote
vendors.provenance: VERIFIED, no price changes. a direct read is blocked with HTTP 403, so https://www.amplenote.com/subscriptions/new was retrieved directly. The page's own markup confirms every figure AND its billing term verbatim — each price sits in a 'plan-billing-summary' block reading, for example, '$5.84/month' followed by '+ tax' and '• billed annually'. Prices confirmed: Pro $5.84, Unlimited $10.00, Founder $20.00, all annual-billed, plus the $96 Ample Agent Pro value claim. Plan names confirmed as Personal, Pro, Unlimited, Founder. Because all three paid prices are annual-billed rates with no month-to-month figure anywhere on the page, no monthly price is recorded for any of the three — an earlier version of this record was right. An earlier version of this record's exclusion of the stale /help/plans_and_prices_billing lineup (Basic $6.99, Pro $11.99, Founder $29.99) is upheld: those plan names no longer match the live page.

plans.name: Personal
plans.notes: Labelled 'Free forever' on the pricing page. Notes, tasks and calendar, mobile apps, and installation on Windows or macOS as a PWA. Two caveats printed right on the card: file uploads are capped at 5 MB and the plan is 'licensed for non-commercial use' — and customer support is explicitly marked 'not included'. Every new account also starts with a free two-week trial of Pro features.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Published as '$5.84/month + tax • billed annually' (wording confirmed verbatim in the page markup); the page shows no month-to-month rate, so no monthly price is recorded rather than 5.84. Adds the native desktop app, Graph View, the Peek/sidebar note viewer, two-way sync with a Google or Outlook calendar, 6 colour themes, tag sharing for group collaboration, Table of Contents insertion and file uploads larger than 5 MB. No annual saving percentage is printed on the live page. Downgrading or switching billing cycle requires emailing support rather than self-serve.

plans.name: Unlimited
plans.notes: Published as '$10.00/month + tax • billed annually'; no month-to-month rate is shown, so no monthly price is recorded. Everything in Pro plus Vault Notes (client-side encryption of sensitive content), publishing notes as web pages, access to the desktop MCP Server so an LLM can read and write to the account, and 8 colour themes. If the MCP server or published notes matter to you, this is the floor tier.

plans.name: Founder
plans.notes: Published as '$20.00/month + tax • billed annually'; no monthly price is recorded, for want of a published monthly rate. Everything in Unlimited plus a bundled install of the Ample Agent Pro plugin, which the page values at $96/year of savings, 10 colour themes, early access to new features, 10x votes on the feature roadmap, a dedicated Discord channel and a 1-on-1 onboarding call.

Amplecap clipper for Chrome and Firefox
Desktop MCP Server for LLM read/write access

There is no free tier; the only free access is the 14-day trial ('Start your 14-day trial').

vendors.name: Supernotes
integrations: Supernotes API (full API access on Unlimited)
vendors.provenance: VERIFIED with a notes refinement. https://supernotes.app/pricing renders with the 'Yearly' term preselected and shows Unlimited as '£6' '/ month' with '£72 billed annually'; the Yearly term carries a 25% saving badge and the 4-Year licence a 50% badge. Confirmed the page's currency control lists GBP as the selected base (with EUR, USD, CAD, AUD, NZD, BRL, JPY, CNY, CHF as display options only) and the FAQ states: 'We're based in London, UK. Stripe transactions are charged in Great British Pound, but we accept most currencies... automatically converted using today's exchange rates.' There is therefore no fixed USD list price and no monthly price is recorded rather than an FX estimate. The month-to-month and 4-Year amounts are computed client-side and were absent from the fetched HTML, so no monthly figure was invented. Free-tier copy confirmed verbatim as 'Start with 100 cards' / 'Earn by completing achievements', and the 1200-character soft limit confirmed. CORRECTION to an earlier version of this record's notes: the student discount is not a single 'up to 63%' — the FAQ specifies 50% off with the Student Yearly plan and 63% off with the Student 4-Year licence.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Free forever (£0), and the page stresses 'all essential features are free'. Mobile, desktop and web apps for Mac, Windows, Linux, Android and iOS, fast sync, full offline create/edit, heatmap calendar, realtime collaboration and publishing, plus '49 more features'. The one real limit is cards: the page says 'Start with 100 cards', earned by completing achievements, and the cap can be raised by referring friends — the FAQ states each referral adds 20 cards. Hit the cap and you keep viewing and editing existing cards but can no longer create, like or join new ones.

plans.name: Unlimited
plans.notes: Published in GBP: £6/month billed annually, i.e. £72 billed annually, as displayed with the Yearly term preselected. The page badges Yearly as 25% off and a 4-Year licence as 50% off (the annual discount of 25% is the page's own printed figure, not a derived one). The month-to-month and 4-Year amounts render client-side and were not present in the fetched page, and because Supernotes charges through Stripe in GBP and converts other currencies at daily exchange rates, no fixed USD list price exists — so no monthly price is recorded, and no conversion was applied. Unlimited cards, AI superpowers, full API and integrations, flashcards/tables/maps, supporter badge and priority support — note that priority support is promised only on the Unlimited Yearly plan or the 4-Year licence, not on monthly. Students get 50% off with the Student Yearly plan or 63% off with the Student 4-Year licence (.edu or .ac.uk address).
